message.content:
**Uno – Quick‑Start Rules** | Section | What Happens | |---------|--------------| | **Goal** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or whatever you agree on). Points are earned by being the first to finish each round. | | **Setup** | • 108‑card deck (standard Uno deck).
• Each player draws 7 cards.
• Place the remaining deck face‑down as the draw pile.
• Flip the top card of the draw pile to start the discard pile. | | **Turn Order** | Players take turns clockwise (unless a direction‑changing card is played). | | **Playing a Card** | On your turn you may play **one** card that matches either the **color** or the **number/symbol** of the top card on the discard pile.
• If you have no playable card, you must draw one from the draw pile. If that card is playable, you may play it immediately; otherwise, your turn ends. | | **Special Cards** | 1. **Skip** – Next player loses their turn.
2. **Reverse** – Reverses play direction (or acts like a Skip if only two players).
3. **Draw Two** – Next player draws two cards and misses a turn.
4. **Wild** – You choose the new color.
5. **Wild Draw Four** – You choose the new color; next player draws four cards and misses a turn (must be played only if you have no other playable card). | | **Winning a Round** | When a player discards their last card, they shout “Uno!” if they have one card left. If they forget, the next player must draw two penalty cards.
Points are tallied: the winner gets the sum of all cards left in opponents’ hands (number cards = face value, special cards = 20 points each). | | **Scoring** | First to reach the agreed‑upon point total (commonly 500) wins the game. | --- ### Quick Tips - **Keep track of colors** – If you’re low on cards, try to play a Wild or Wild Draw Four to change the color to something you have more of. - **Watch the “Uno” shout** – If you’re the second‑to‑last player, you can call “Uno” on an opponent who forgets, forcing them to draw two cards. - **Use Draw Two/Draw Four strategically** – Save them for when you’re about to finish or when you can force a player with many cards to draw. Enjoy the colorful chaos!
